review_locator: PMCID:PMC8034822, Fibrosis: From Mechanisms to Medicines, IL-13/TGF-beta section; PMCID:PMC8170303, The Epithelial-Immune Crosstalk in Pulmonary Fibrosis
primary_title: Interleukin-13 induces tissue fibrosis by selectively stimulating and activating transforming growth factor beta(1)
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-13 as stimulating and activating TGF-beta1 in macrophage-rich fibrotic lung; the cited primary demonstrates increased TGF-beta1 production, macrophage localization and protease-dependent activation in IL-13 transgenic mice.
limitations_preserved: Measured TGF-beta1 production and activation in an IL-13 transgenic pulmonary fibrosis model, with macrophages as the major production/deposition site; preserve chronic lung and protease-dependent context and do not infer a universal macrophage secretion mechanism or SCI fibrosis.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC11717358, Exploring neuroglial signaling: diversity of molecules implicated in microglia-to-astrocyte neuroimmune communication
primary_title: TGFbeta signalling plays an important role in IL4-induced alternative activation of microglia
decision_basis: The review identifies the cited primary study showing that IL-4 treatment increases TGF-beta2 expression and secretion by microglia as an autocrine/paracrine output.
limitations_preserved: Capture IL-4-supported TGF-beta2 protein secretion as the measured output; preserve that much secreted TGF-beta2 was latent and that the study used microglial alternative-activation context, without inferring transcript-to-protein kinetics, direct IL4R-to-TGFBR relay or SCI transfer.
